simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַעֲדָן (H4574) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַעֲדָן (maʻădân) means a delicacy or (abstractly) pleasure (adverbially, cheerfully) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 15 32.

definitions.full: H4574. maadan or maadannah [ מַעֲדָן ] noun [masculine] dainty (food), delight only plural; — מֶלָךְ מַעֲדַגֵּי Gen 49:20 royal dainties ; לְמַעֲדַנִּים הָאֹכְלִים Lam 4:5 those who ate (according to dainties) daintily ; more Generally לְנַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ מַעֲדַנִּים וְיִתֵּן Prov 29:17 he shall give delight to thy soul (|| וִינִידֶ֑ךָ ). — מַעֲדַנּוֺת , also below ענד . II. עדן (√ of following; compare perhaps Assyrian edinu , plain (in word-lists), Schr Cot Gen 2:8 , Dl Pa 79 f. ; other views see Di 2:8 ).
